spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Is desired state reconciling, and which resource or controller is blocking it?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/operations/cluster-upgrades.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Flux resource readiness
spec.description:
Current Ready conditions read from the API with revision/suspension shown separately. A live controller process can still fail reconciliation.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Suspended resources
spec.description:
Declared suspension; do not report deliberate suspension as a controller crash.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Reconcile failures
spec.description:
Controller process metrics supplement the CR Ready state; controller PodMonitor access needs explicit network-policy integration.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Unready workloads

spec.expr: sum by (k8s_cluster, app) (max by (k8s_cluster, app, kind, workload) (homelab_workload_desired_replicas{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"})) - sum by (k8s_cluster, app) (max by (k8s_cluster, app, kind, workload) (homelab_workload_ready_replicas{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}))

spec.description:
Effective desired minus Ready per tracked app/site. A zero-replica standby is not a failed application.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Node CPU utilization
spec.description:
CPU busy fraction per nested node view. Do not sum shared WSL kernel capacity as independent physical nodes.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Node memory available
spec.description:
Shared WSL kernel memory view on nested Talos nodes. Cross-check Windows physical available memory.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Source revisions fetched
spec.description:
Each Git or OCI revision Flux fetched in the range and when, from the source's artifact. Fetched isn't applied: the Ready transitions of the Kustomizations that use it show the apply.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Helm releases deployed

spec.expr: max by (k8s_cluster, resource, chart_version, app_version, release_status) (max_over_time(homelab_flux_release_deployed_timestamp_seconds{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__range])) * 1000 > $__from

spec.description:
The latest install or upgrade of each HelmRelease in the range, from its release history, with the chart and app version and whether it deployed or failed. An upgrade that changed only values keeps its version.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Flux Ready transitions
spec.description:
When each Flux resource's Ready condition last changed in the range, per resulting state, from the API. Only the latest change per state is kept: a resource that flapped shows its last False and its last True.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Node versions

spec.expr: min by (k8s_cluster, node, os_image, kubelet_version, kernel_version) (min_over_time(timestamp(kube_node_info{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"})[$__range:5m])) * 1000

spec.description:
When each node's Talos, kubelet and kernel versions were first seen in the range, at 5-minute resolution. Two rows for one node mean it was upgraded, and the later row is when.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
